title: Both Pawns Run
setup: Black has just pushed its pawn to the fourth, and the white king is close enough to be tempted.
hint: Turning back to stop its pawn costs a move; count both runs to the eighth rank before you decide.
explanation:
## The Idea

Chasing the f-pawn only draws. {{c6}} wins the race: after {{Kg3}} the pawn runs to c7 and queens on c8 while Black's pawn has only reached f3, and your new queen and king then stop the runner.

In a pure race, count both pawns' moves to the last rank before you turn back to chase.
